proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal ― Federal Securities Laws Mandatory Arbitration Bylaw
proposals.proponent: Hal Scott/The Doris Behr 2012 Irrevocable Trust, Harvard Law School, Lewis 339
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to adopt a mandatory arbitration bylaw for federal securities law claims, barring class actions, with a five-year sunset provision.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the adoption of this proposal
